title: Epicurean Sardinian Lamb Lasagna
description: A rich and savory lasagna dish originating from the Italian island of Sardinia, featuring halal-friendly lamb and a unique blend of spices. It's the perfect comfort food for a lazy Sunday.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions, then set aside.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery, and cook until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add garlic, chilli bean paste, and tomato paste to the skillet. Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add ground lamb to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until it's no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
Add nimono simmer (or beef broth) to the skillet, and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low and let it cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a separate pan, cook eggplant slices over medium heat until they're tender, about 5-7 minutes. Set aside.
In a large bowl, combine cooked lasagna noodles, lamb mixture, and cooked eggplant slices. Mix well to combine.
In a separate bowl, combine mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Mix well to combine.

To assemble the lasagna, spread a layer of lamb mixture in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top, followed by a layer of cheese. Repeat this process, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the lasagna from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes before serving. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Slice the lasagna into individual portions and serve hot.
